state.instruction: Judge visible phone crops in order. Only image 1 is shipping. Images 2 and 3 are Stitch design concepts. Compare their hierarchy and useful actions, model estimates no audience result or rights.

first.instructions: Which first screen most quickly gets someone to an actual work worth exploring?

identity.instructions: Which screen carries the most relevant, distinctive art direction? Do not assume an image shown in a concept is an approved original.

action.instructions: Which screen most clearly explains what the visitor can do next with a piece?

editorial.instructions: Which screen is the most useful starting point for a real, credited social campaign using originals from Share?

notes: The wall mock invented attribution and a CC-BY licence.
The single-feature mock invented a live broadcast.
Both were retained as design concepts.

state.instruction: Use only the distilled public issue evidence. Do not claim current defects or infer private owner views.

issues.evidence: A traced 306-second release guard spent 270 seconds uploading. Extra test scope cannot improve network upload.
A much shorter deploy guard concealed first-edit-to-live elapsed time above six minutes. Measure the whole path.
Owner had to repeat intent. The audit retains the objective, exact attempt, reason, and real next result.
Multiple branding systems initially became recolours of the same concept. Compare distinct complete treatments at the intended sizes.
Controls shifted size after interaction. An initial screenshot hid the usability fault. Exercise the changed interaction.
A tools-first redesign improved action reach but removed art the owner wanted. Restore successful accepted elements and grade character separately from task success.
Recommendations and owner reaction needed a clear hierarchy and private revisions. Keep suggestion, owner answer and actual result distinct.
Catalogue metadata predicted editorial roles but provided no pixels, crop or rights evidence. Inspect actual renders and retain exact media revision.
Stitch programme exhausted its screen allowance on previous runs. Reuse existing projects and use only a few meaningfully distinct candidates.
Existing upstream Fungi watch records changes. Reuse it for a scoped, practical test of original continuity.
Social previews recur as stale metadata, image or cache failures. Record real URL, current bytes and consumer behaviour.
The flagship depends on a newcomer finishing an owned build; browsing the setup page is partial evidence.
